paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Kohen. In Rabbi Yehudah ben Pazi’s name, Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot; he asked Rabbi Yose, Terumot, beginning of chapter 3; Migbela, his brother; in R. Sheshet’s name, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Bameh Ishah; he ruled in Kefar Akavyah, Jerusalem Talmud, Nazir, last chapter, halakhah 3.
